causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: At 1.24 pm, due to extreme localised storm conditions, the Heywood interconnector which links Victoria and South Australia failed.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: Six high voltage transmission towers in between Lismore and Moorabool in Victoria collapsed resulting in South Australia being electrically isolated from the rest of the market.

causes.label: constraint_violation
causes.quote: To manage this, the market operator (AEMO) invoked constraints which limited the output of several generators and resulted in the price reaching $9832/MWh for the 2 pm trading interval in South Australia.

causes.label: constraint_violation
causes.quote: cheaper priced generation was limited by the constraints used to manage the Heywood interconnector outage and a large increase in FCAS requirements.

causes.label: fcas_co_optimisation
causes.quote: cheaper priced generation was limited by the constraints used to manage the Heywood interconnector outage and a large increase in FCAS requirements.

causes.label: fcas_co_optimisation
causes.quote: When there is an increase in local FCAS requirements, there will be a trade-off between the amount of energy and FCAS that some generation units can provide.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Within the 2 pm trading interval a small number of generation units experienced technical issues with their plant and adjusted the amount of generation available to the market.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: there was a decrease in capacity priced less than $5000/MWh within the trading interval which was a result of the technical issues experienced by some generation plant.

interconnectors_named.name: Heywood interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: At 1.24 pm, due to extreme localised storm conditions, the Heywood interconnector which links Victoria and South Australia failed.

interconnectors_named.name: MurrayLink interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: This saw a decrease of 35 MW of imports from Victoria across the Heywood interconnector, however this was more than offset by an increase of 84 MW of imports across the MurrayLink interconnector.

intervals.quote: The spot price for the 2 pm trading interval in South Australia reached $9832/MWh.

network_outages.quote: At 1.24 pm, due to extreme localised storm conditions, the Heywood interconnector which links Victoria and South Australia failed.

peak_price.quote: The spot price for the 2 pm trading interval in South Australia reached $9832/MWh.

rebid_set_price.quote: Overall rebidding from low to high prices did not contribute to the high priced trading interval in South Australia.

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: High temperatures in Victoria and New South Wales led to high demand in both regions.

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Demand reached 13 144 MW in New South Wales for the 3.30 pm trading interval , this was around 500 MW less than the highest demand recorded for the 2019/20 summer.

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: in Victoria , demand reached 9507 MW for the 5 pm trading interval which was the highest demand recorded for the 2019/20 summer.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: Availability in these trading intervals was around 700 MW lower than forecast four hour prior, mainly due to plant issues in New South Wales and lower than forecast wind generation in Victoria.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: For the 3 pm and 3.3 0 pm trading intervals around 285 MW of wind generation was dispatched , 35 0 MW lower than earlier forecast.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: AGL's Liddell unit 1 (450 MW) had been offline since the previous day due to a tube leak while EnergyAustralia's Mount Piper unit 2 (650 MW) had been offline since 23 January for a planned outage.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Snowy Hydro's Colongra power station experienced technical issues which saw its unit 2 (169 MW) fail to start after receiving a target to generate.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: AGL's Liddell unit 2 and Bayswater unit 4 plants also reduced their availability due to a plant failure and milling limits respectively.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: These outages saw a combined 330 MW of generation capacity unavailable during the 3 pm and 3.30 pm trading intervals.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: The outage r esulted in no imports being available to Victoria from South Australia across Heywood during the high price periods.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Victoria was not able to import any gene ration from South Australia and it required imports from New South Wales to meet demand, opposite from what was forecast four hours prior.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: the loss of cheaply priced imports from South Australia resulted in higher priced local generation from Victoria and New South Wales being dispatched to meet demand.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: generators in both regions regularly rebid capacity from high to low prices in the lead up to the start of, and during, trading intervals.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: at certain tim es across the afternoon high priced capacity above $5000/MWh was still required to meet demand and resulted in the spot price exceeding $5000/MWh a number of times.

causes.label: administered_pricing_or_intervention
causes.quote: AEMO activated the RERT contracts for both regions. RERT was activated from 3. 30 pm to 9.30 pm with contracted reserves of 185 MW in Victoria and 134 MW in New South Wales.

interconnectors_named.name: Heywood interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: The outage r esulted in no imports being available to Victoria from South Australia across Heywood during the high price periods.

interconnectors_named.name: Vic-NSW interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: Victoria was not able to import any gene ration from South Australia and it required imports from New South Wales to meet demand, opposite from what was forecast four hours prior.

intervals.quote: The spot price for the multiple trading intervals between 3 pm to 7 pm exceeded $5000/MWh.

network_outages.quote: The outage r esulted in no imports being available to Victoria from South Australia across Heywood during the high price periods.

rebid_set_price.quote: Rebidding of capacity from low to high prices did not contribute to the price exceeding $5000/MWh in any of the high priced trading intervals on the day.
